limitations: Only the one-dimensional central stabilization of the three-dimensional Heisenberg algebra is treated. Equivalent group-side coverage under Lazard correspondence for odd prime fields remains a residual literature risk.
scientific_integrity: The arbitrary-field-size formula is proved by a complete classification of subalgebras by their image in the two-dimensional central quotient and by an exact count of the only possible nonpermutable pairs. Independent finite enumeration is used only as a check, not as an infinite proof.
title: Exact subalgebra commutativity degree after a one-dimensional central stabilization of the Heisenberg algebra
